_comment: English names of first-level subdivisions where Natural Earth's name_en is wrong or misleading: a curated dataset (CC BY 4.0, see datasets/LICENSE.md). packbuild's world pack takes each admin-1 unit's name from here, else Natural Earth's name_en (unless another unit of the same country has the same name_en, or it is the country's own name: then Natural Earth's name), else its name. Fields: id (the world pack's admin1 id, iso:<ISO 3166-2 code>); name (the English name placewise shows); ne_name_en (Natural Earth's name_en, for reading); notes.
